Rishi / Vivek —

NetPulse (strategic AI customer) is asking for an aggressive package: ~20% off list for year 1, a substantial SLA credit for recent outage, and a term reset to align with their fiscal year. Current GAAP ARR from this account is ~$420,000/year (net of existing discounts). Their procurement timeline is tight — they need signed terms before June 15 to route internally.

Options I see (rough sketches):
- Commercial package A (conservative): 12% renewal discount + $25k one-time credit + add targeted SLA language (higher credit for repeated outages).
- Package B (sales-forward): 18% discount + $50k credit + 12-month term reset (higher churn risk if we don't get firm renewal).

I'm asking for pre-approval to negotiate up to $50k in one-time consideration or up to 18% discount, but I need executive sign-off beyond that. Please advise if we should propose Package A or B, or a hybrid.

Attached: draft counter terms (numbers are placeholders).

Thanks,
Camila

Camila / Rishi —

Reviewed the numbers. Quick finance reality check: a straight 18% off $420k is ~ $75.6k gross concession; with expected margin and ramp our acceptable upper bound without clear expansion commitment is ~ $50k in total economic concession (mix of discount + credit).

Counter I recommend we put forward now (pre-approval ask to execs):
- One-time credit: $30,000 (applied to first invoice)
- Renewal discount: 12% off list for year 1
- Term reset: 12 months (shift renewal anniversary)
- SLA: add a targeted 99.9% uptime guarantee and cap outage compensation to 1x monthly invoice per SLA incident (we should avoid open-ended multipliers)

This hits ~$50k concession and preserves long-term price integrity. Anything > $50k or >15% discount needs LAURA BENNETT sign-off (per deal desk policy).

I've attached a quick P&L tab and the counter redline. If you want me to seek Laura's approval, say so and I'll package the ask (impact, comps, recommended alternate terms).

-Vivek
[Attachment: redwood_counter_proposal_2027.xlsx]

- Renewal discount: 15% off list for year 1
